d:
The Clippers defeated the Hornets, 113-105 tonight in LA. Darius Garland finished with a team-high 27 points along with 7 assists and 6 rebounds for the Clippers, while Max Strus tallied 14 points, 4 assists and 4 three pointers in the game. Coby White recorded 21 points, 2 three pointers. The Clippers improve their record to 4-8 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 4-9 for the season.
